response.markdown:
As of **October 10, 2026**, the price of **24-carat gold in India is approximately ₹1,51,420 per 10 grams** (₹15,142 per gram), up ~0.47% from yesterday. [0] [1]

City-wise prices vary slightly — for example, **Delhi** is around ₹1,51,570 per 10g and **Chennai** around ₹1,52,843 per 10g (LiveMint). Prices also differ by jeweller (e.g., Tanishq quoted ₹1,51,200/10g yesterday). These rates are **before** making charges, GST (3%), and any applicable local taxes.
